keyPoints: Anuvanshikta (heredity) me maata-pita ke gun santaan me pahunchte hain — aankhon ka rang, kaan ki lo aur jeebh modne ki kshamta iske udaharan hain.
Mendel ne matar ke paudhon par saat peedhiyon tak prayog karke anuvanshikta ke niyam khoje; unhe anuvanshiki ka janak kehte hain.
Prabhavi gun (dominant) ek hi prati me dikhai deta hai, jabki aprbhavi gun (recessive) tabhi dikhta hai jab dono prati aprbhavi hon.
Manav sharir ki har koshika me 23 jode gunsootra (chromosome) hote hain; bachche ka ling pita ke shukranu ke gunsootra (X ya Y) se tay hota hai.
DNA me jeev ke sabhi gunon ki jaankari koot (code) ke roop me likhi hoti hai; ye koot protein banakar gun prakat karta hai.
Samaan maata-pita ki santaan me bhi antar hota hai — ye bhinnata (variation) prakriti ka niyam hai aur vikas ka aadhar hai.
Aam galti: ladke ya ladki ke janm ka dosh maa par dalna; ling ka faisla hamesha pita ke gunsootra se hota hai, maa hamesha X hi deti hai.
